info.name: Transportayo API
info.description: Set the three demo passwords in Collection Variables from your local .env. Run all folders in order or follow the README to demonstrate vehicle CRUD manually.

exec: pm.test("Bearer token required", function () { pm.expect(body.message).to.equal("Bearer token required"); });
pm.test("Credential error", function () { pm.expect(body.message).to.equal("Invalid email or password"); });
pm.test("Response has the saved ID", function () { pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get("vehicleId")); });
pm.test("Response has the saved ID", function () { pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get("testCustomerId")); });
pm.test("Response has the saved ID", function () { pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get("testDriverId")); });
pm.test("Seeded vehicle exists", function () { pm.expect(body.items.some(vehicle => vehicle.plateNumber === "DEMO-001")).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Response has the saved ID", function () { pm.expect(String(body.id)).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get("rideId")); });
